about_the_game:
THE STORY

Upon your arrival in Brighthaven, you discover that your uncle has passed away. He leaves behind a once-flourishing delivery business, now in a sorry state. Amidst forgotten packages and abandoned offices, you find a legacy in jeopardy.

Determined to honor his memory, you decide to start from scratch. You will transform his empty warehouses into "Rage Rooms," outlets where souls exhausted by daily life can finally release their stress and unleash their frustration.

Now it's your turn to play: take the reins, build a team, and turn this declining empire into the ultimate refuge for all those who need to break everything to rebuild themselves.

What to expect:

  • Become an outstanding manager: Recruit a team, manage salaries and skills to optimize the operation of your rooms.

  • Build your demolition empire: Invest your profits to expand your premises, unlock new themed rooms, and ever more surprising objects to destroy.

  • Strategy at the heart of chaos: Manage your finances, launch marketing campaigns, and make crucial decisions to attract a diverse clientele and make your business prosper.

  • Advanced customization: Design your "Rage Rooms" to meet your customers' desires, maximize their satisfaction... and your revenue!
